content:
Last month, OpenAI teased a hardware product named after Codex. Today, the company officially launched its collaboration with Work Louder: the Codex Micro keyboard, priced at US$230.

Here is the product introduction:

The keyboard comes in two versions: clicky and silent.

The official website states: "Each Agent key lights up with different RGB effects based on Codex's real-time status, so you can tell at a glance which agent is thinking, running, waiting, or done before switching conversations."

The product page also lists three Codex-exclusive features:

  • Instant skill triggers: flick the joystick to launch common Codex workflows, such as reviewing PRs, debugging errors, or refactoring code.
  • Centralised core actions: command keys give you dedicated shortcuts for your most-used actions, including accept, reject, push-to-talk, new chat, and more. Less switching, faster delivery.
  • Adjust compute intensity: turn the dial to instantly adjust the reasoning level. Keep things fast for simple tasks, and go all-out when deep thinking is needed.
